hero.subheadline: Michael Duhaime and the Quality Renovation crew gut and rebuild bathrooms, custom showers and the trim around them, and have been contracting since 1990.

image.alt: Remodeled bathroom with dark gray paneled wainscoting, hex tile floor, antique dresser vanity with vessel sink and brass light, by a bathroom remodeling Smithfield contractor

paragraphs: Quality Renovation LLC has been doing bathroom remodeling Smithfield homeowners notice for the details. One customer had new bathrooms with custom marble stonework and new millwork made to match the trim profile already in the rest of the house, so the rooms look like they always belonged there.

Another homeowner, after 30 years in her house and many contractors, had them tear out a custom shower and rebuild it properly, then hang her caddy and paint before they left. A third has hired them five times, for two kids' baths, a master bath gut, a front porch and a finished basement.

items.name: Bathroom remodels and gut renovations
items.blurb: From a kids' bath refresh to a full master bath gut, bathrooms are what Google lists them for. Recent projects include custom marble stonework, new tile floors and paneled wainscoting matched to the trim elsewhere in the house, as in the bathroom shown above.

image.alt: Bathroom with dark painted wainscoting, white hex tile floor, toilet and window with cafe curtain

items.name: Custom tile showers
items.blurb: When a shower is failing, the crew demolishes it and rebuilds it properly. One rebuild used large marble-look plank tile, a pebble floor, a grab bar and matte black fixtures. The customer said they even put up her shower caddy and did painting.

image.alt: Shower with marble-look plank wall tile and matte black shower valve and handheld shower head

items.name: Kitchens
items.blurb: Kitchens are printed first on the company's business card, alongside baths, doors and windows. Their Facebook page says they specialize in bathrooms, kitchens, flooring, doors and windows. Call Mike to talk about cabinets, layout and finishes for your kitchen.

items.name: Custom stairways and fine carpentry
items.blurb: Custom built stairways and fine finished carpentry are on their card. On Facebook they shared custom stairs and an overhang for the side entrance of the Saint Philip Church rectory, designed and contracted by Quality Renovations. Inside, they match existing millwork profiles.

image.alt: White church building with a new side entrance, gabled overhang and railed stairs

items.name: Basements, porches and additions
items.blurb: Bigger projects too. One client's list includes a front porch install and a finished basement. For complex ideas, they work with an architect who draws up plans, which that client found very useful when applying for permits.

image.alt: Finished basement room with gray walls, white baseboards and white six-panel doors

items.name: Flooring, doors and windows
items.blurb: Tile and wood flooring, doors and windows are listed on the company's business card and Facebook page, and doors come up in their Google reviews. Ask about these on their own or as part of a bathroom or kitchen remodel.

image.alt: Corner of a shower with marble-look plank tile walls and a round pebble mosaic floor

why_choose_us.h2: Why Smithfield homeowners call Quality Renovation

items.title: Contracting since 1990
items.text: Their business card says since 1990, licensed (Lic. 4192) and fully insured. That is decades of kitchens, baths, stairways and finish carpentry around Smithfield.

items.title: Trim that matches your house
items.text: A reviewer described custom millwork made to match the profile in other rooms of the house, plus custom marble stonework, at a fraction of the other quotes they received.

items.title: Plans for complex jobs
items.text: For projects that need drawings, they work with an architect. One client said having plans in hand was very useful when applying for permits for a new front porch.

items.title: They show up and clean up
items.text: One five-time client says they make it simple: they show up, clean up and execute the plan. Another praised their professional manner and genuine concern.

about.h2: About Mike, Josh and the crew
about.text: Quality Renovation LLC is a general contractor at 2 Farnum Pike in Smithfield, Rhode Island. The company business card lists Michael Duhaime, licence 4192, fully insured, since 1990, with kitchens, baths, doors, windows, custom built stairways, tile and wood flooring and fine finished carpentry. Reviewers know the team as Mike and his crew, and one thanks Josh, Joe and Mike by name. Joshua Duhaime is tagged with Michael on their Facebook project posts. Customers describe a crew that is professional, efficient and easy to work with.
about.owner_role: Name on the company business card (role not printed); reviewers say 'Mike and his crew'. Team also includes Josh (Joshua Duhaime) and Joe.

image.alt: Quality Renovations business card listing Lic. 4192, fully insured, since 1990 and Michael Duhaime

steps.title: Call Mike
steps.text: Call (401) 480-0110 any day between 7 AM and 7 PM and describe the bathroom, kitchen or other project you have in mind.

steps.title: Plan the job
steps.text: The crew looks at the space and works out the plan. For complex ideas, their architect draws up plans you can use for permits.

steps.title: Build it properly
steps.text: Demolition, tile, stonework and carpentry are done by the crew. Clients say they show up, clean up and execute the plan.

steps.title: Finishing touches
steps.text: Small things get done before they leave. One client noted they put up her shower caddy and handled painting too.

items.name: Olivia L.
items.text: Quality Renovation was absolutely Amazing! I've owned my house for over 30+ years and had many contractors. Quality Renovation is T op Notch! Their professional manner, superior work & genuine concern was truly authentic! They completely demoed my custom shower & rebuilt it the proper way. They even went above & beyond, putting up my caddy, painting..etc I am blessed to have met such Great people! Josh, Joe & Mike are the Best! Thank you!!

items.name: Patrick H.
items.text: Hands down the best decision you will make when looking for a general contractor.  They make it very simple, they show up, clean up and execute the plan.  They just finished their 5th project with me.  Kids bath remodel 1, master bath gut and remodel, kids bath remodel 2, front porch install and finally, finished basement.  If you have an idea that is a bit complex, they have an architect they work with to draw up the plans (my front porch), very useful when applying for permits when you have plans in hand.  They are my go to, hands down.  Happy to show off their work.

items.name: Cameron M.
items.text: Mike and his crew did a fantastic job replacing our bathrooms! They did all custom marble stonework, custom millwork to match the profile that exists in other rooms of the house, and did it at a fraction of other quotes that I received! Highly recommend! 👍😁👍

service_area.text: Quality Renovation LLC works from 2 Farnum Pike, Smithfield, RI 02917, the same address printed on the company business card. Their Facebook page describes them as Smithfield, RI general contractors, and Smithfield is the town on their Google profile. If you are planning a bathroom, kitchen or carpentry project in or near Smithfield, call (401) 480-0110 to see whether it fits the schedule.

faq.h2: Questions about bathroom remodeling in Smithfield

items.a: Yes. The company business card states Lic. 4192 and fully insured, and says the business has been operating since 1990. If you need a copy of the insurance certificate for your records or for a permit, ask Mike when you call (401) 480-0110.

items.q: Can you fix a shower another contractor built badly?
items.a: Yes. One Google reviewer who had owned her home for over 30 years said they completely demolished her custom shower and rebuilt it the proper way. Their photos show rebuilt showers with large marble-look plank tile, pebble mosaic floors, grab bars and black fixtures.

items.q: Do you handle permits and plans?
items.a: For complex ideas, they work with an architect who draws up the plans. A client who had a front porch built said having plans in hand was very useful when applying for permits. Ask about this when you describe your project and they can tell you what it needs.

items.q: What else do you do besides bathrooms?
items.a: The business card lists general contracting, kitchens, baths, doors, windows, custom built stairways, tile and wood flooring, and fine finished carpentry. Reviewers also describe a front porch and a finished basement, and their Facebook page shows custom stairs and an overhang built for a church rectory.

Google lists Quality Renovation LLC as open every day of the week, Sunday through Saturday, from 7 AM to 7 PM. Call (401) 480-0110 during those hours to talk to the team about your project or to set up a time for them to see the space.

final_cta.text: Call Mike and the Quality Renovation crew, any day from 7 AM to 7 PM.
